starter.cli:
# Alice has no channel with Dina, so the payment must hop: Alice -> Bob -> Chan -> Dina.
INV=$(JIFUNZE_NODE=dina lncli addinvoice --amt 21000 --memo "safari" | jq -r .payment_request)
lncli payinvoice --force "$INV"
